paragraphs:
Olivia loved the park. She wanted to build the tallest sandcastle. "Reach the clouds!" she thought. She piled sand, but the tower felt wobbly and fell.
Leo watched. "Hello," he said. "Share my shovel?" Olivia nodded .
They took turns, scooping sand and patting it firm. "We need a steady base," Leo said. They built a strong base, then added layers.
The sandcastle grew so tall! Olivia felt proud. "Look
scenes: Olivia and Leo are at a sunny park sandpit, collaborating to build a tall, sturdy sandcastle. They are scooping sand and patting it firm, with shovels and buckets around them.
